cities.name: Jaipur
cities.registryBasis: Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha is an official state cadastral service, but this batch did not verify a Jaipur-target revenue record. The city-scoped lead is JDA urban GIS, documented in jaipur-urban-gis-diagnostic.json; it is a municipal GIS source, not yet a verified cadastral registry response.

cities.name: Varanasi
cities.registryBasis: Official UP BhuNaksha resolves district 197 वाराणसी, Sadar tehsil 00996 and real nearby revenue-village maps/plots (Shivpur, Domari); these are city-region registry records, though neither nearby sample contains the WUP center.

cities.name: Indore
cities.registryBasis: Official Indore district Revenue Department page identifies local revenue administration and its online directory of patwari/revenue inspectors/tehsildars; official Indore district officers page lists the भू-अभिलेख (land records) office. Sources: https://indore.nic.in/en/departments/revenue-department/ and https://indore.nic.in/en/district-officers-contacts-directory/.

cities.name: Nagpur
cities.registryBasis: Official Nagpur District Superintendent of Land Records page identifies the city district land-records authority; Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh officially documents eMaps for city-survey/plot maps and property-card access.

cities.name: Kalyan-Dombivli
cities.registryBasis: KDMC official ArcGIS service metadata exposes city-survey boundary layer (survey_no, ward_id, village_name); a municipal parcel registry layer is documented, but WUP center may lie outside KDMC in Ulhasnagar.
